description: Reports a pushed fix: the branch and the commit sha. The Deployer reads the commit from the git host, checks the change (no CI, agent settings or .env files; no secrets), then deploys it or opens a pull request for the person to ship, depending on the project's settings.

branch.description: The branch the fix was pushed to

note.description: What changed, in a sentence or two

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: report_fix
title: Report the fix you pushed
